item.title: TVS Motor Company Surges 31% In February 2026, Two Wheelers And EV Lead The Charge
item.description: TVS Motor Company reported a strong 31% year-on-year growth in February 2026, selling 5.29 lakh units. Domestic two-wheeler sales rose sharply, scooters and motorcycles posted healthy gains, EV sales surged 60%, and exports hit a record 1.58 lakh units, reflecting robust demand both in India and global markets.
